stores.title: Stores
stores.settings_desc: Connect a store with a plugin and choose where an ingredient search looks first.
stores.desc: A store is connected with a plugin: a small service that Nutreek asks for products, prices and availability. The integrated ones run inside Nutreek; you can also connect one of your own. Open Food Facts stays a source like the others.
stores.no_key: Stores with an address of their own cannot be connected until whoever runs this instance sets NUTREEK_SECRET_KEY, which seals their tokens. Integrated stores do not need it.
stores.sources_hint: Drag to change the order, or use the arrows: a search starts from the first.
stores.off_desc: Local copy of the catalogue · built in
stores.name: Name
stores.token_keep: Leave empty to keep the current one
stores.delete_confirm: Disconnect {{.Name}}? Your ingredients stay, without their link to its products.
stores.what.title: What is a plugin?
stores.what.body: A service that answers Nutreek in JSON: search, product, availability. Integrated stores come with Nutreek (see github.com/easly1989/nutreek-store-plugins); to connect your own, the contract is in docs/store-plugins.md.
stores.what.private: By default only public addresses are reached. For a plugin on your own network, whoever runs the instance sets NUTREEK_STORES_ALLOW_PRIVATE.
stores.error.no_key: Set NUTREEK_SECRET_KEY first: it seals the token.
stores.error.url: The address must start with https:// (http:// only where private addresses are allowed).
stores.error.invalid: A name, an address and a token are needed, and up to 5 stores can be connected.
stores.test.failed: {{.Name}} did not answer. Check the address and the token.
stores.error.token_needed: A new address needs the token again: the old one is not sent to it.
stores.builtin.title: Integrated stores
stores.builtin.hint: They run inside Nutreek and read the store's public website: nothing to install or set up. Prices are those of the site's default store.
stores.builtin.nothing_to_set: An integrated store has nothing to set. You can try it or disconnect it.
stores.builtin.desc.conad: Products, prices, stock and nutrition from Conad's online shop.
stores.prices.partial: Prices updated ({{.Count}}); {{.Missing}} could not be refreshed, try again.
